test_attention_backend_forward: test the forward pass of FluxPipeline with different attention backends like flash_hub and native
test_attention_backend_compile: test the compiled forward pass of FluxPipeline transformer with torch.compile and different backends
check_backend_supported: check if a given attention backend name is supported by the FluxPipeline transformer
check_slices_match: check if generated image output slices match expected bfloat16 tensor values within tolerance
run_attention_backend_tests: run the attention backend test suite by setting RUN_ATTENTION_BACKEND_TESTS env variable and executing pytest
